name: The Startup
description: Twelve monthly turns running a small consumer-product company from $10,000 and two staff. A hidden, seeded market decides the outcome: price elasticity, marketing with diminishing returns and carry-over brand awareness, seasonality, staff capacity, storage costs, stockouts that lose sales and reputation, and scripted events — a competitor price war, a supplier cost spike announced a month ahead, a viral review, and a loan offer whose terms may or may not be worth it. Each month the model sets price, production, marketing and hiring, then reads a P&L report, customer feedback and market news. Scores are normalised between an autopilot that repeats the pre-launch plan and an oracle that knows every hidden parameter, so it rewards models that learn the market from their own results and plan ahead for events.
hook: $10,000, twelve months and a hidden market — can it beat autopilot?
author: Gauntlet Core
